response.sql: WITH status_tallies AS (SELECT archstat AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS tally FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), status_shares AS (SELECT status, tally, tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM status_tallies) SELECT status, tally, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM status_shares QUALIFY share > AVG(share) OVER ()
